_instructions.what_is_this_file: This file is the single source of truth for all TikTok Ads report jobs. It controls which reports are generated, when they run, and records the outcome of every run.
_instructions.how_to_add_a_report: Append a new object to the 'reports' array. Copy the structure of an existing entry. Give it a unique 'id' (lowercase, hyphens only). Set 'enabled' to true.
_instructions.how_to_disable_a_report: Set 'enabled' to false. Do not delete the entry.
_instructions.how_to_reschedule: Update the 'schedule.frequency' field using plain English. The expanded_schedule will be regenerated automatically on the next cron run.
_instructions.how_to_check_for_errors: Look at the last entry in each report's 'runs' array. If 'status' is 'failed', read 'error' for a short summary, 'error_step' for which step failed (fetch / generate / upload), and 'error_detail' for the full error message.
_instructions.template_selection: The PPTX template is chosen automatically based on the number of campaigns in 'campaign_ids'. Templates live in the templates/ directory and are named Brand_Objective_1_campaign.pptx through Brand_Objective_5_campaign.pptx.
_instructions.expanded_schedule_explained: expanded_schedule is auto-generated from schedule.frequency. It lists concrete run datetimes for the next 2 months. The cron runs every hour and checks this list — do not edit it manually. It is regenerated automatically when fewer than 14 days of pending entries remain.

runs_field_reference.triggered_at: ISO timestamp of when this run started.
runs_field_reference.campaigns_json: Path to the generated campaigns JSON data file.
runs_field_reference.creatives_json: Path to the generated creatives JSON data file.
runs_field_reference.pptx_path: Path to the generated PPTX file.
runs_field_reference.drive_url: Google Drive URL of the uploaded deck.
runs_field_reference.error_step: Which step failed: fetch | generate | upload (null on success).
runs_field_reference.error_detail: Full error message or stack trace excerpt (null on success).

_instructions.never_do_this: Never delete entries from a report's 'runs' array. Always append.

schedule_format.description: Write schedule.frequency in plain English. All times are Pacific Time.

field_reference.id: Unique identifier for this report. Use lowercase letters and hyphens only. Used in output filenames.
field_reference.label: Human-readable name shown in logs and the slide deck title.
field_reference.schedule.frequency: When to run this report. Plain English, Pacific Time. See schedule_format above.
field_reference.schedule.date_range_mode: How to determine the reporting date range. 'previous_week' automatically pulls Sun-Sat of the prior week. 'static' uses schedule.date_range.start and .end.
field_reference.schedule.date_range.start: Start date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Only used when date_range_mode is 'static'.
field_reference.schedule.date_range.end: End date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Only used when date_range_mode is 'static'.
field_reference.campaign_ids: List of TikTok campaign IDs to include (1-5). The number of campaigns determines which template is used automatically.
field_reference.output_dir: Directory where generated JSON data files and PPTX files are saved.
field_reference.drive_folder_id: Google Drive folder ID to upload the finished deck into.
field_reference.enabled: Set to true to run this report on schedule. Set to false to pause it.
